title: MemoryGrantsListRequest
description: List grants: full view for admin, or exactly its own grants for a self-view principal. The principal_id filter is an admin-only target selector and never reassigns the requester (§6.4). Grant: admin (full view) or self-view. Read-only; the response payload is returned directly (§7.0.2).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor bound to principal, space, subject, selection/filter, snapshot marker and engine_policy_version. Any state or grant change invalidates it with CURSOR_INVALID (§7.0.7, MEM-R026).
cursor.title: Cursor
